The question asks for the leading scorer of the fifth-place team in the Western Conference two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs. DeRozan was traded in the 2018 off-season, making the relevant season 2019–20. In the 2019–20 NBA season, the fifth-place team in the Western Conference was the Oklahoma City Thunder, and their leading scorer was Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, not Danilo Gallinari or Luka Dončić. However, the ground truth answer provided is Luka Dončić, who was the leading scorer of the seventh-seeded Dallas Mavericks, not the fifth-place team. The predicted answer identifies Danilo Gallinari as the leading scorer for Oklahoma City Thunder, which is also incorrect (though the team is correct, the player is not). Therefore, the "Ground Truth Answer" (Luka Dončić) is not present in the "Predicted Answer" in any form.
